basic_details.job_title: District Social Welfare Office, Mayiladuthurai Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 MTS, Account Assistant and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The District Social Welfare Officer, Mayiladuthurai (Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Mission Shakti scheme) is inviting applications for 3 posts, one each of Account Assistant, IT Assistant for PMMVY Scheme and MTS, on contract basis. The application form is to be downloaded from mayiladuthurai.nic.in and the application sent to the District Social Welfare Office, 5th Floor, Room No: 524, District Collector's Office, Mayiladuthurai. The last date is 27 November 2026; the notice does not say whether this is the date of receipt or of dispatch.

qualification.details: Age limit for all three posts: Below 35 Years. The notice prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation. | Qualification: Graduate / diploma in accounts / other disciplines having accounts as a subject. Experience: At least 3 years experience of working with the Government / Non Government organizations in related domain. | Qualification: Graduation with working knowledge in computers, IT etc. Experience: Minimum of 3 years experience in data management, process documentation and web-based reporting formats, at State or District level with government or non-government IT-based organizations. | Qualification: 10th or 12th Class pass from a recognised board. | The notice does not name the degree or discipline beyond what is printed above. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: About the Recruitment
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the District Social Welfare Officer, Mayiladuthurai, under the Mission Shakti scheme and the District Women Empowerment Centre, which works on Central and State schemes for women. Staff are engaged on contract basis only up to March 2027. Preference will be given to candidates residing in Mayiladuthurai district.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the Mayiladuthurai District website, mayiladuthurai.nic.in. Send the application to: District Social Welfare Officer, District Social Welfare Office, 5th Floor, Room No: 524, District Collector's Office, Mayiladuthurai District. Telephone given in the notice: 04364-212429. The notice does not mention the postal mode, an email address or an envelope superscription.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Age limit for all three posts: Below 35 Years. The notice prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation. Qualification: Graduate / diploma in accounts / other disciplines having accounts as a subject. Experience: At least 3 years experience of working with the Government / Non Government organizations in related domain. Qualification: Graduation with working knowledge in computers, IT etc. Experience: Minimum of 3 years experience in data management, process documentation and web-based reporting formats, at State or District level with government or non-government IT-based organizations. Qualification: 10th or 12th Class pass from a recognised board. The notice does not name the degree or discipline beyond what is printed above. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: District Social Welfare Office, Mayiladuthurai Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints duties only for MTS (in the column where the other posts show experience): Data entry. Any task as assigned by the functionaries at the SANKALP: DHEW at the state level.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Account Assistant, 1 IT Assistant for PMMVY Scheme and 1 MTS.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 27 November 2026, as printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Account Assistant?
faq.answer: Graduate / diploma in accounts / other disciplines having accounts as a subject, with at least 3 years experience of working with Government / Non Government organizations in related domain.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for IT Assistant for PMMVY Scheme?
faq.answer: Graduation with working knowledge in computers, IT etc., and a minimum of 3 years experience in data management, process documentation and web-based reporting formats at State or District level with government or non-government IT-based organizations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for MTS?
faq.answer: 10th or 12th Class pass from a recognised board.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Below 35 Years for all three posts.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The proposed salary is Rs. 20,000 per month for Account Assistant and IT Assistant, and Rs. 12,000 per month for MTS.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download the application form from mayiladuthurai.nic.in and send it to the District Social Welfare Officer, District Social Welfare Office, 5th Floor, Room No: 524, District Collector's Office, Mayiladuthurai District.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. Staff are engaged on contract basis only up to March 2027.

faq.question: Q10. Who gets preference?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to candidates residing in Mayiladuthurai district.
